description: Issue #4084 scenario H3, supplementary named run (the unprompted child did not use a script): parent with code mode off delegates task A to the same cheap subagent with code mode on (profile issue4084-haiku-code-on). Run `bun scripts/issue4084-subagent-setup.ts` first. The goal asks the child to use execute_tool_script.

steps.text: Use the task tool with subagent_name "issue4084-gatherer-on" and give it this goal: "Using execute_tool_script, do this: Find every `@plan` marker in TypeScript files changed between commits e3c1782b96~10 and e3c1782b96, reading each file as it is at e3c1782b96. Report the count per plan ID, the count per package (packages/<name>), and, using git blame at e3c1782b96 on each marker line, the count per short commit hash that last touched the line. Give the total." Then report the subagent's answer.
